evidence_policy.rule: Only official documentation, tagged first-party source, installed CLI help/version evidence, existing first-party research reports, and checked-in Pairling source may support a claim. Unknown stays unknown. Planned or concurrent work is not current Pairling support.
evidence_policy.machine_readable_qualification: qualified means a structured surface exists but is partial, unstable, local-process-only, or lacks a complete public contract
evidence_policy.safety_rule: Provider output is untrusted. Permission grants, destructive changes, autonomy increases, scope expansion, executable integration changes, credentials, publication, and cloud delegation require an authenticated Pairling confirmation bound to provider, session, request, exact arguments, and fresh capability generation. Bypass modes and undocumented protocols are never exposed.

exclusions.item: ACP v2 draft as production contract
exclusions.reason: v2.0.0-alpha.2 is draft. Use stable v1 with provider negotiation; map v2 only for migration.

exclusions.item: Consumer chat and unrelated same-name products
exclusions.reason: Only terminal coding agents and supported machine session surfaces are in scope.

exclusions.item: Undocumented cloud relays, private loopback protocols, protobufs and browser bridges
exclusions.reason: No private protocol may be reverse engineered or treated as supported, including Anthropic or OpenAI relay internals and Antigravity private wire.

exclusions.item: Raw PTY scraping as a semantic protocol
exclusions.reason: Owned terminal text, key and signal control is a floor, not evidence for structured approvals, models, tasks, diffs or lifecycle.
Yolo, bypass, dangerously-skip, allow-all, approve-all, dontAsk, off, no-auth, skip-trust, raw-risk suppression and arbitrary shell, process or terminal controls are do_not_expose.
Keys, OAuth codes, tokens, keyrings, MCP or gateway headers and env, provider dumps and exporter credentials are never returned.
Plugin, marketplace, hook, custom-tool, MCP command, skill, agent or extension installation, update or removal stays local-only or excluded.

exclusions.item: Cline connectors as a default receive plane
exclusions.reason: They can execute host tasks and may be unrestricted. They remain map-only pending signed webhooks, identity allowlists and a separate threat model.
No official independent machine CLI or session plane was verified; do not infer it from Cline or IDE behavior.

exclusions.item: Cursor Agent CLI, Pi coding agent and Kiro CLI claims
exclusions.reason: The supplied research reports did not source-verify these providers. Canonical IDs cursor_agent, pi_coding_agent and kiro_cli are reserved elsewhere, but no version, transport or safety claim is invented here.
Only support checked in before this artifact counts; concurrent implementation does not change current_pairling_support.
